interpretation.development_bank_status: The development banks were visible while the agents were written. Their numbers are descriptive and must not be quoted as sealed promotion evidence.
interpretation.ladder_claim: Phase 4 establishes a reproducible reference population. A higher rung is a strictly larger capability set, not a proven stronger player. Where a more capable rung scores worse the result is preserved and diagnosed by ablation.
interpretation.no_expert_claim: No agent in this report is expert-validated, tuned against an expert, or claimed to be strong.
interpretation.sample_size_warning: Independent base deals, not transformed games, are the unit of inference. Cross-play uses a deliberately small shared bank and is descriptive only.

performance.note: Wall-clock values are hardware dependent. The engine revalidates the whole deal state on every accepted action, so it dominates the measurement; the relative column is the meaningful comparison.
